Edgar Saltus, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edgar-saltus/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edgar Saltus, the author, died 1921.

First publication of the text used: between 1888 and 1919 (SE colophon: 'Short Fiction was compiled from short stories and novellas published between 1888 and 1919 by Edgar Saltus.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the works were first published between 1888 and 1919, all before 1931, so the text is in the public domain in the United States.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. Every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (the last to die died in 1921), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
